📖 How to use

  1. Enter your follower count.
  2. Enter your average engagement rate %.
  3. Pick your niche.
  4. Get the suggested rate per post plus story/reel ranges.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the rate calculated?

Enter followers, average engagement rate %, and niche — the tool applies a CPM-based formula adjusted for engagement and niche multiplier.

What is the exact formula?

Base CPM of $15 per 1,000 followers, scaled by engagement (your ER ÷ 3% baseline) and a niche multiplier (finance/tech higher, lifestyle lower).

Are these rates guaranteed?

These are starting-point estimates for negotiation — real rates vary by audience quality, deliverables and region.

Why does niche matter?

The niche multiplier reflects typical advertiser demand: finance and tech pay more per follower than general lifestyle.
